title: Too Short to Hold Egg Carton; Not Dishwasher Safe
text:
Too Short to Hold Egg Carton; Not Dishwasher Safe. These VTOPMART FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS (6Pack, 1.5L) were disappointing. They are slightly too short to hold a cardboard carton of one dozen large eggs. If you use the lids, they don’t hold very much. The containers themselves take up a lot of refrigerator space. The drainage liners are flimsy.

The containers are NOT dishwasher safe. They are fairly expensive for what they are (about $18 on Amazon, or $3 each). They seem like they belong in a Dollar Store for about $1 each, because they’re undersized and not very useful.
